name: Jujutsu Kaisen Phantom Parade
description:
About This Game

What is "Jujutsu Kaisen: Phantom Parade"?

◆The world of "TV Anime" and the story of "Jujutsu Kaisen" unique to the game◆

The anime story is recreated with new full voices. Additionally, the story is told from the perspectives of various characters, fully voiced.

◆Use your hands to control Cursed Techniques and exorcise Cursed Spirits in battles just like the TV anime.◆

Battles will unfold in high quality. Format your own team and exorcise powerful Cursed Spirits.

◆Experience the battles of "Jujutsu Kaisen" unique to the game with your own hands◆

"Domain Investigation" to challenge the Cursed Spirits that exist on each floor. Clear the Domains with your grown characters.

◆The new scenes from "Jujutsu Kaisen" called "Recollection Bits" depicted in the game.◆

Newly depicted scenes from "Jujutsu Kaisen" called "Recollection Bits". Equip your characters with "Recollection Bits" to enhance their abilities.
